items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A list of sections that people open and close by pressing each heading.

items.name: agent-indicator
items.title: Agent indicator
items.description: A small moving mark that shows an agent at work, one to a view.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A short message in the page that tells people something is done, wrong or worth knowing.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert dialog
items.description: A window that asks one question before a step that cannot be undone.

items.name: app-shell-01
items.title: App shell
items.description: The frame every page of an app sits in, with its main navigation beside the page.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect ratio
items.description: A box that keeps its width-to-height ratio, holding an image's space before it loads.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file or picture that goes with a message, with its picture or mark, its name and a line about it, its state on the way, and its actions.

items.name: audio-player
items.title: Audio player
items.description: A bar that plays a sound file, with a timeline, a playback rate button and mute.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A small round picture of a person or team, showing initials when there is none.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small label of a word or two that shows the status of something.

items.name: brand-icon
items.title: Brand icon
items.description: Another company's logo, shown for an integration, a source or a way to sign in.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A row of links showing the path to this page, so you can go back up.

items.name: bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.description: The framed surface of a message in a conversation, with its look, its side and reactions over its edge.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A button you press to do one thing now, like Save or Send.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: A row of buttons for actions on the same thing, like Archive and Delete.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month of days on the page, for choosing a date, several dates or a range.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A box on the page that holds one thing and what belongs to it.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A set of slides that people page through with buttons, a swipe or the arrow keys.

items.name: chain-of-thought
items.title: Chain of thought
items.description: The steps of one answer as they happen, each with what it found, behind one line that opens.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Numbers across kinds, over time, as parts of a whole, as flows between stages, or as a spark beside a figure.

items.name: chat
items.title: Chat
items.description: The whole thread, ready to use, with the messages in a Message scroller, an empty state before the first and the Prompt input under them.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A box you tick to turn a choice on or off, alone or in a group.

items.name: checkpoint
items.title: Checkpoint
items.description: A point in the conversation the person can return to.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: A box of highlighted code, with its language named, line numbers and a copy button.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A section that opens and closes from a button, for detail most people can skip.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A field you type into to find one value in a long list, then choose it.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A search box over a list of actions, where you type to find and run one.

items.name: confirmation
items.title: Confirmation
items.description: A step that waits for the person's yes, with the request and its answers, then what was decided.

items.name: connect-api-key-01
items.title: Connect API key
items.description: Choose a service, paste its key, and see it connect, in one card with no dialog.

items.name: container
items.title: Container
items.description: A page's content in one column of a reading width in the page's middle, with room for a child that runs the whole width.

items.name: context
items.title: Context
items.description: How much of the model's context window the conversation has used, with its tokens by kind.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context menu
items.description: A menu of actions for a thing, opened by right-clicking or long-pressing it.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: A button that copies a value to the clipboard and shows that it did.

items.name: data-grid
items.title: Data grid
items.description: A spreadsheet in the page, where people edit cells in place and copy and paste.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: A table of rows that people can sort, search, select and page through.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: A field for a date, typed in or chosen from a calendar it opens, or a range.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A window over the page for one short task, closed by its own buttons.

items.name: diff-viewer
items.title: Diff viewer
items.description: A before-and-after view of changes, marked by line for code and by word for prose, for one file or several.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel that slides up from the bottom for a short task on a phone.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: A list of actions on one thing, such as Rename or Move, opened from a button.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: The message a list shows when it has nothing in it, or failed to load.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A control with its label, its description and the error it shows.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File upload
items.description: An area in a form where you drop or choose files, then see them listed.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: A layout that stacks a form's fields in one column, with its buttons at the end.

items.name: heading
items.title: Heading
items.description: A title for a page, section or card, with its outline level and size set separately.

items.name: hold-button
items.title: Hold button
items.description: A button you press and hold to confirm what cannot be undone.

items.name: hooks
items.title: Hooks
items.description: The hooks the components share: an action's states, copying, a long run, focus going back, and which edges of a scroller have more beyond them.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover card
items.description: A small card that previews where a link goes, shown when you point at it.

items.name: icon-tile
items.title: Icon tile
items.description: A small square with an object's icon, shown at the top of its details panel.

items.name: image-upload
items.title: Image upload
items.description: Image upload

items.name: inline-citation
items.title: Inline citation
items.description: A source in the sentence it supports, opening on hover or focus to its title, a line about it and a link.

items.name: inline-edit
items.title: Inline edit
items.description: A value read as text that turns into a field where it stands, to change it in place.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A box for typing one line of text, like a name or an email address.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input group
items.description: A text box with a unit, an icon or a button inside, like a search field.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A row of boxes for a one-time code or PIN, one character in each.

items.name: inspector-01
items.title: Inspector
items.description: A side panel, built from data, that inspects one record.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A list row that names a thing and links to it or acts on it.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A key or shortcut to press, shown as it is printed on the keyboard.

items.name: key-value
items.title: Key and value rows
items.description: A list of facts about one thing, each a short name with its value.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: The name of a control you can see, tied to it so a press on the name reaches the control.

items.name: lib
items.title: Lib
items.description: What every component builds on: the tokens' StyleX names, the shared styles and variables, icons, layers, words and small utilities.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Words you press to go to another page or address, in a sentence or alone.

items.name: markdown
items.title: Markdown
items.description: An agent's answer in Markdown, shown as formatted text, even while it is still arriving.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: A line in a conversation that marks what happened, a status, a note, or a word between two rules.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A row of menus, like File, Edit and View, that hold an app's actions.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: One message in a conversation, the row round its surface, with its avatar, header, actions and footer.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message scroller
items.description: The scrolling transcript of a chat, which follows the reply, settles a new turn near the top and keeps your place.

items.name: model-selector
items.title: Model selector
items.description: The model an assistant answers with, and how hard it thinks, chosen from one chip that opens one panel.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation menu
items.description: A row of a site's main links across the top, with groups that open as panels.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number field
items.description: A box for typing a number, with buttons to step it down and up.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page header
items.description: The top of a page, with its title, a line about it, its actions and tabs.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Previous and Next buttons that page through a long list and show where you are.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A small panel beside the control that opened it, for a quick task.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A bar or ring showing how far a task has come, or that it is running.

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: Prompt input
items.description: Where a person writes to an assistant, with mentions as real tokens in the text, files, dictation and Send that turns into Stop.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: The questions an assistant asks and waits on, one at a time, each answered with a choice, several, or the person's own words.

items.name: queue
items.title: Queue
items.description: What waits to be sent or done while an answer streams, the messages sent ahead and the to-dos, in sections that fold.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: A short list of choices where you pick exactly one, all shown at once.

items.name: reasoning
items.title: Reasoning
items.description: The model's own thinking, as words, shown while it streams, then folded into one quiet line.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: A set of panels people resize by dragging the handles between them or with arrow keys.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll area
items.description: A box whose content scrolls inside it, with a thin bar that shows while in use.

items.name: section-header
items.title: Section header
items.description: A heading for one part of a page, with a sentence and that part's actions.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A field that opens a list below it, so you can choose one value.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A thin line that sets apart groups of content on the page.

items.name: share-dialog-01
items.title: Share dialog
items.description: Share one thing with people at a level of access, in a dialog.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel along a side of the window, for details or a task beside the page.

items.name: shimmer
items.title: Shimmer
items.description: A line of words that says something is working, with light passing across it.

items.name: side-panel
items.title: Side panel
items.description: A panel beside a page that shows the details of one thing, in sections.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A column of an app's main places down one side, which folds away or down to its icons.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Placeholder shapes that stand in for content while it loads, so the page does not jump.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A bar with a handle you drag to set a number, or two for a range.

items.name: snippet
items.title: Snippet
items.description: A value you can copy, whole on one line, with a copy button at its end.

items.name: sources
items.title: Sources
items.description: What an answer drew on, folded under it as a count that opens to the list.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A small turning icon that shows something is loading or working.

items.name: stack-trace
items.title: Stack Trace
items.description: An error and its stack frames, from a failed tool call or a command.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: A key figure with its label and how much it changed, alone or in a row.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: A list of named steps that shows which are done, current, still to come or failed.

items.name: subagent
items.title: Subagent
items.description: Work handed to another agent, shown as its own run, with what it was asked, its tool calls and what it found.

items.name: suggestion
items.title: Suggestion
items.description: Short prompts a person can send to the assistant with one press, in a row that scrolls sideways.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A control you press to turn a setting on or off, taking effect at once.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A table of facts in rows and columns, for people to compare at a glance.

items.name: table-of-contents
items.title: Table of contents
items.description: A long page's sections beside it, the one you are reading marked.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A row of tabs that switch between views of one thing, one at a time.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: A short label that sorts or names something, in a word or two.

items.name: tags-input
items.title: Tags input
items.description: A box where you type several values, like labels, each shown as a tag.

items.name: terminal
items.title: Terminal
items.description: The output of a shell command an assistant runs, as it streams.

items.name: test-results
items.title: Test Results
items.description: The results of a test run an assistant made, its counts, its suites, its tests and their failures.

items.name: text
items.title: Text
items.description: Body text for paragraphs and labels, in one of four sizes and four colours.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A box for several lines of text that grows taller as you write.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme toggle
items.description: A control for choosing light, dark or the system's look, and any themes the product offers.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A small message that pops up for a moment to say something happened.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed to keep a choice on, like a view or text style.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group
items.description: Toggle group

items.name: tokens
items.title: Tokens
items.description: Every colour, space, corner, edge, shadow, time and curve as CSS variables (tokens.css), and the modes and themes (themes.css). Import both once, at the root.

items.name: tool
items.title: Tool
items.description: One call to one tool, its state on its line, opening on what went in and what came back.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short hint that shows when you point at a control or tab to it.

items.name: trace
items.title: Trace
items.description: The building block for a line of an assistant's work, with a mark, a title and a body that opens, for a step no part built on it names.

items.name: tree-view
items.title: Tree view
items.description: A list of nested items, like folders and files, that open and close.
